Ways to work together

Bring in experience where it matters most.

01

Architecture review

An independent assessment of one application or platform before a major investment, migration, or redesign.

Outcome: a system diagram, prioritized findings, and an improvement roadmap.

02

Cloud & migration readiness

Review dependencies, landing zones, identity, networking, delivery, and operational readiness across Azure, AWS, or GCP.

Outcome: a readiness assessment, target architecture, and phased migration plan.

03

Fractional architecture guidance

Recurring design reviews, engineering mentorship, and technical decision support without a full-time leadership commitment.

Outcome: documented decisions and a clear technical direction. Meeting cadence and hours agreed upfront.

Start with a focused review

Know what deserves attention first.

The initial engagement covers one application or platform boundary. A typical review takes about two weeks once the agreed documentation and stakeholders are available.

Implementation, production changes, and ongoing incident support are separate scopes. Recommendations reflect the evidence available during the review.

Request a scoped proposal

Your review includes

  • Discovery meeting and documentation review
  • Current architecture and dependency diagram
  • Five prioritized findings with evidence and tradeoffs
  • A 90-day improvement roadmap with suggested ownership
  • A findings meeting and written assessment

What to bring

Business goals, an existing diagram if available, technology inventory, and the top issues your team wants to solve. We agree how information will be shared before the review begins.
